title: imghdr was removed in Python 3.13: detect PNG by its magic bytes

problem.description: PEP 594 removed imghdr in 3.13. For a single format, compare the 8-byte signature; for many formats use a maintained library (e.g. filetype, Pillow).

files.detect.py:
PNG = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"


def kind(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return "png" if f.read(8) == PNG else None

files.check.py:
from detect import kind

with open("photo.dat", "wb") as f:
    f.write(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + b"\x00" * 24)
with open("notes.png", "wb") as f:
    f.write(b"just text, not an image")
assert kind("photo.dat") == "png", kind("photo.dat")
assert kind("notes.png") is None, kind("notes.png")

limitations.proves: PNG content is recognized by signature and a text file named .png is rejected.
limitations.does_not_prove: Detection of formats other than PNG (imghdr knew ~15).
